varieties.name: Sigarar Utang
varieties.tasteProfile: Varietas unggul nasional tahan penyakit, aroma rempah manis, buah matang, dan body lembut seimbang.

varieties.name: Lini S795 (Jember)
varieties.tasteProfile: Persilangan Kent x S288, body sirupis tebal, rasa cokelat moka, maple, dan keasaman buah lembut.

varieties.name: Ateng Super / Gayo 1 (TimTim)
varieties.tasteProfile: Keturunan Hybrido de Timor x Caturra, body pekat, rempah hangat, cokelat gelap & herbal manis.

varieties.name: Borbor (Gayo 2)
varieties.tasteProfile: Varietas lokal unggul Aceh Gayo, aroma bunga manis, buah tropis & aftertaste panjang bersih.

varieties.name: P88 (Gayo 3)
varieties.tasteProfile: Seleksi lokal dataran tinggi Gayo, karakter buah nangka, rempah manis & keasaman cerah.

varieties.name: Abyssinia (AB3)
varieties.tasteProfile: Varietas heritage awal Indonesia, aroma herbal elegan, teh hitam, rempah manis & floral.

varieties.name: Andungsari (AS 1 & AS 2K)
varieties.tasteProfile: Aroma bunga jeruk manis, buah tropis, keasaman segar & aftertaste manis berkepanjangan.

varieties.name: Kartika (Kartika 1 & 2)
varieties.tasteProfile: Keturunan Caturra x HDT (Catimor), keasaman sitrun cerah, manis tebu & cup sangat bersih.

varieties.name: Komasti
varieties.tasteProfile: Komposit Andungsari Tiga, citarasa bersih, manis gula aren, kacang panggang & floral halus.

varieties.name: USDA 762
varieties.tasteProfile: Seleksi klasik Ethiopia-Indonesia, body kental, kakao pekat, rempah manis & citrus.

varieties.name: Kopyol
varieties.tasteProfile: Mutasi lokal Bali Kintamani dengan karakter jeruk kintamani segar, floral & body ringan.

varieties.name: Juria (Typica Flores)
varieties.tasteProfile: Typica kuno Flores bertajuk tinggi, rasa cokelat susu, karamel, kacang & buah apel.

varieties.name: Bergendal
varieties.tasteProfile: Typica klasik peninggalan kolonial, aroma floral halus, teh hitam, manis gula tebu.

varieties.name: Sidikalang (Typica Sumatera)
varieties.tasteProfile: Karakter body sangat kental, dark chocolate, kacang panggang & aftertaste manis.

varieties.name: Lasuna & Garunggang
varieties.tasteProfile: Varietas heirloom lokal Danau Toba, karakter rempah herba segar, jeruk & cokelat.

varieties.name: Besemah Pagaralam
varieties.tasteProfile: Khas lereng Gunung Dempo, aroma rempah hangat, gula merah & body mantap.

varieties.name: Robusta BP 42 / BP 358 / BP 936
varieties.tasteProfile: Klon unggul Fine Robusta Indonesia, crema tebal, dark chocolate, hazelnut & manis karamel.

varieties.name: Liberika Tungkal Komposit (Libtukom)
varieties.origin: Tanjung Jabung Barat, Jambi / Meranti / Kayong
varieties.tasteProfile: Kopi lahan gambut ikonik Indonesia, aroma nangka matang, floral eksotis & dark cocoa.

varieties.name: Excelsa (Coffea liberica var. dewevrei)
varieties.tasteProfile: Aroma buah nangka, asam beri tart segar, floral unik & aftertaste cokelat gelap.

varieties.name: Peaberry (Kopi Lanang)
varieties.tasteProfile: Biji tunggal bulat padat (5% panen), konsentrasi gula & aroma lebih intens dengan body bulat.

varieties.name: Longberry
varieties.tasteProfile: Biji memanjang berdensitas tinggi, aroma melati, buah beri cerah & manis madu.

varieties.name: Typica
varieties.tasteProfile: Induk arabika klasik tertua, kejernihan tinggi (clarity), floral bersih & manis tebu seimbang.

varieties.name: Bourbon
varieties.tasteProfile: Manis karamel alami tinggi, keasaman kompleks, body halus & aftertaste cokelat.

varieties.name: Pink Bourbon
varieties.tasteProfile: Hibrida genetik langka asal Ethiopia-Kolombia, aroma melati, grapefruit merah, peach & manis madu.

varieties.name: Yellow Bourbon
varieties.tasteProfile: Body creamy lembut, rasa kacang almond madu, buah kuning & cokelat susu.

varieties.name: Red Bourbon
varieties.tasteProfile: Manis buah plum, ceri merah, gula merah karamel & keasaman seimbang.

varieties.name: Orange Bourbon
varieties.tasteProfile: Keasaman jeruk mandarin manis, karamel & aroma bunga jeruk.

varieties.name: Striped Bourbon (Aji Bourbon)
varieties.tasteProfile: Bourbon eksotis dengan notes peach, teh oolong & keasaman buah tropis.

varieties.name: Bourbon Pointu (Laurina)
varieties.tasteProfile: Alami rendah kafein (~0.6%), keasaman lembut, floral melati & rasa super clean.

varieties.name: Caturra
varieties.tasteProfile: Mutasi kerdil Bourbon, keasaman sitrun cerah, manis gula tebu & clean cup.

varieties.name: Catuai (Red / Yellow)
varieties.tasteProfile: Persilangan Mundo Novo x Caturra, manis karamel, kacang panggang & buah apel.

varieties.name: Mundo Novo
varieties.tasteProfile: Persilangan alami Typica x Bourbon, body tebal manis cokelat susu & hazelnut.

varieties.name: Pacas
varieties.tasteProfile: Mutasi Bourbon, floral manis, buah batu (peach) & body lembut seimbang.

varieties.name: Villa Sarchi
varieties.tasteProfile: Mutasi kerdil Bourbon, keasaman anggur cerah, buah persik & manis madu.

varieties.name: Maragogype (Elephant Bean)
varieties.tasteProfile: Mutasi biji raksasa Typica, tekstur halus, floral ringan & manis buah pir.

varieties.name: Pacamara
varieties.tasteProfile: Persilangan Pacas x Maragogype, ukuran biji besar, buah tropis eksotis, juicy & kompleks.

varieties.name: Maracaturra
varieties.tasteProfile: Persilangan Maragogype x Caturra, keasaman buah segar, floral & manis karamel.

varieties.name: Pache (Común / Colis)
varieties.tasteProfile: Mutasi Typica dataran tinggi, manis halus, aroma bunga & aftertaste bersih.

varieties.name: Java
varieties.tasteProfile: Keturunan Ethiopia Abysinia via Jawa, aroma teh hitam, rempah manis & floral elegan.

varieties.name: Kent
varieties.tasteProfile: Seleksi India klasik, aroma rempah halus, buah matang & manis cokelat.

varieties.name: Kona Typica
varieties.tasteProfile: Typica kepulauan vulkanik Hawaii, sangat halus, manis macadamia, karamel & floral.

varieties.name: Jamaica Blue Mountain
varieties.tasteProfile: Keturunan Typica klasik, sangat halus, nol kepahitan, floral & cokelat susu.

varieties.name: Tekisic
varieties.tasteProfile: Seleksi unggul Bourbon El Salvador, manis karamel intens & body bulat.

varieties.name: Venecia
varieties.tasteProfile: Mutasi Caturra berbuah besar, manis cokelat, sitrun halus & body tebal.

varieties.name: San Ramon
varieties.tasteProfile: Mutasi kerdil Typica, manis gula merah & keasaman lembut.

varieties.name: Arusha
varieties.tasteProfile: Kerabat Typica/Bourbon Afrika Timur, rasa buah mangga manis, jeruk & cokelat.

varieties.name: Geisha / Gesha
varieties.tasteProfile: Raja kopi specialty dunia: melati spektakuler, bergamot earl grey, white peach & madu.

varieties.name: Sidra (Bourbon Sidra)
varieties.tasteProfile: Hibrida genetik langka asal Ethiopia, rasa red berry intens, hibiskus, peach & manis sirup.

varieties.name: Chiroso
varieties.tasteProfile: Landrace genetik langka asal Ethiopia di Kolombia, aroma melati, lemongrass, peach & teh putih.

varieties.name: Wush Wush
varieties.tasteProfile: Aroma bunga lavender intens, buah beri gelap, anggur merah & manis kompleks.

varieties.name: Sudan Rume
varieties.tasteProfile: Varietas liar super langka, aroma jahe manis, kapulaga, melati & buah tropis.

varieties.name: Eugenoides (Coffea eugenioides)
varieties.tasteProfile: Spesies induk Arabika super rendah kafein, rasa manis stevia/gula kapas alami & sereal susu.

varieties.name: Mejorado (Typica Mejorado)
varieties.tasteProfile: Persilangan unik Ekuador dengan kejernihan ekstrem, floral melati, buah persik & manis madu.

varieties.name: Pink / Yellow / Red Tabi
varieties.tasteProfile: Persilangan Typica x Bourbon x Timor, tahan karat daun dengan karakter floral & buah batu.

varieties.name: Ombligon
varieties.tasteProfile: Kultivar langka berbiji oval berpusar, rasa beri intens, cokelat susu & permen buah.

varieties.name: Papayo
varieties.tasteProfile: Kultivar heirloom Kolombia berbentuk pepaya, aroma floral, jeruk manis & buah tropis.

varieties.name: Ethiopian Heirloom (74110 / 74112 / 74158)
varieties.tasteProfile: Ratusan landrace liar Ethiopia: melati, bergamot, blueberry, peach & teh hitam.

varieties.name: SL28
varieties.tasteProfile: Ikon kopi Kenya: blackcurrant (kismis hitam) pekat, grapefruit, hibiskus & juicy acidity.

varieties.name: SL34
varieties.tasteProfile: Body lebih tebal dari SL28 dengan ledakan buah beri gelap, jeruk merah & manis gula tebu.

varieties.name: SL14
varieties.tasteProfile: Tahan kekeringan dengan notes kismis, jeruk manis & aftertaste cokelat.

varieties.name: Ruiru 11
varieties.tasteProfile: Hibrida tahan CBD/karat daun dengan rasa kismis merah, buah batu & body penuh.

varieties.name: Batian
varieties.tasteProfile: Varietas unggul modern Kenya berbuah tinggi dengan profil blackcurrant & sitrun cerah.

varieties.name: K7
varieties.tasteProfile: Seleksi French Mission Bourbon, keasaman lembut, buah tropis & karamel.

varieties.name: Yemenia
varieties.tasteProfile: Kelompok genetik baru khas Yaman, aroma rempah eksotis, delima, kurma & cokelat pekat.

varieties.name: Castillo
varieties.tasteProfile: Varietas utama Kolombia modern: keasaman cerah, apel merah, karamel & manis panela.

varieties.name: Variedad Colombia
varieties.tasteProfile: Pendahulu Castillo, seimbang, cokelat susu, karamel & sitrun lembut.

varieties.name: Cenicafé 1
varieties.tasteProfile: Keturunan Caturra x Timor generasi terbaru, ukuran biji seragam & manis buah cerah.

varieties.name: Catimor (T5175 / CR-95 / Lempira / Ihcafe 90)
varieties.tasteProfile: Persilangan Caturra x HDT, produktif, body mantap, cokelat & rempah manis.

varieties.name: Sarchimor (Obata / Parainema / Marsellesa / Villa Sarchi x HDT)
varieties.tasteProfile: Persilangan Villa Sarchi x HDT: kualitas cup tinggi, buah tropis, herbal segar & karamel.

varieties.name: F1 Hybrids (Centroamericano / Starmaya / Milenio / Mundo Maya)
varieties.tasteProfile: Hibrida F1 generasi baru dengan potensi skor cupping 86–90+, floral, buah manis & produktivitas tinggi.
